items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: 7 FR-01.06/FR-01.07 lines each enforced or downgraded with a documented reason; the 4 REQ3.05 enforced-untested lines untouched (no edits to _validate_test or REQ3.05's own backfill).

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Every new check wraps JSON parsing in try/except (JSONDecodeError, OSError) and treats non-dict/non-list/malformed shapes defensively; none raises.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user input reaches SQL/HTML; added symlink-escape containment (_safe_project_file/_is_within) for every fixed-name project file read, per external review finding.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 53 new/updated tests assert on CheckResult outcomes (ok/severity/detail); each check has pass, fail, and skip paths covered, plus two symlink-escape regression tests.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No DB access; globbing is bounded to project-controlled directories (.shipwright/planning/, e2e/); no N+1 or unbounded-fetch patterns introduced.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Follows _project_gate_extras.py/_project_gate_wiring.py naming precedent; both new verifier files stay at or under the 300-line guideline (300, 167).

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: New READERS only over pre-existing serialized formats (shipwright_test_results.json, e2e-results.json, design-fidelity-report.json) — no new format introduced, no writer changed, so no producer/consumer round-trip was created; fixture tests mirror the documented real shapes from step-3.5/step-3.7.
